Logan — attaching my completed sheet (mina_filled_scorecard.pdf). Highlights:
- Technical 4 (good on latency-sensitivity and kernel tradeoffs; struggled with a KV-cache TTL edge-case I probed)
- Impact 4
- Communication 4

Anchor/context: when I asked about a work sample involving multi-tenant KV invalidation, Carlos recommended per-customer TTLs + async sweep. That design works for small fleets but creates worst-case latency spikes if sweeps coincide.

Recommendation: If we make an offer, include a short design take-home or schedule a 30-minute follow-up with an infra engineer to validate the approach.
